title: Level Change Terms Recorded against the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Levels
content:
What a guest may do with the level of their Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election, and by when, is written
into the level itself. The first four columns state whether moving up and moving down are open before the trip
starts and once it has started; the lead hours are the hours before the trip starts by which a level change
must be asked for; the decision window is the hours the marketplace has to decide a level change request; and
the last three columns record the proration basis, the percentage of the difference credited back on a move
down, and the mid-trip change fee recorded against the level.

| Protection level | Moving up before the trip starts | Moving up once the trip has started | Moving down before the trip starts | Moving down once the trip has started | Lead hours before the trip starts | Decision window (hours) | Proration basis recorded | Downgrade credit (percent) | Mid-trip change fee recorded (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Declined Protection | yes | no | no | no | 4 | 2 | the whole trip | 0 | 0.00 |
| Keyturn Minimum Protection | yes | no | yes | no | 4 | 2 | the remaining whole days | 50 | 20.00 |
| Keyturn Standard Protection | yes | yes | yes | no | 2 | 4 | the remaining whole days | 60 | 20.00 |
| Keyturn Advantage Protection | yes | yes | yes | yes | 2 | 4 | the remaining whole days | 70 | 15.00 |
| Keyturn Premier Protection | yes | yes | yes | yes | 1 | 6 | the remaining whole days | 80 | 0.00 |
| Keyturn Business Traveler Protection | yes | yes | no | no | 1 | 8 | the remaining whole days | 0 | 0.00 |

## The four switches restated

Moving up before the trip starts is open on all six levels. Moving up once the trip has started is open on the
four levels from Keyturn Standard Protection upward. Moving down before the trip starts is open on four levels
and shut on Keyturn Declined Protection and Keyturn Business Traveler Protection. Moving down once the trip has
started is open on Keyturn Advantage Protection and Keyturn Premier Protection alone.

## Timing read on hypothetical clocks

The lead hours and the decision window move in opposite directions along the ladder: the lead hours fall from 4
on the two lowest levels to 1 on the two highest, while the decision window rises from 2 hours to 8. A
hypothetical request made on a level whose lead is 2 hours, entered 3 hours before the trip is due to start,
therefore stands ahead of that level's lead; the same request entered 1 hour before the trip is due to start
does not. A hypothetical request recorded on a level whose decision window is 4 hours is inside that window at
the fourth full hour after the timestamp on the request and outside it at the fifth.
